notes: S2/F65 (§12.2 checks 1c, 6, 10): the receipt's signer is a deterministic P-384 test certificate (self-signed, timeStamping EKU), and the receipt is signed with that key using RFC 6979 deterministic ECDSA; the case's trust anchor is that certificate. The SignerInfo uses ecdsa-with-SHA384 with NULL parameters; for ECDSA the parameters MUST be absent (§12.2 1c X6 table).
